faq.q: What is the origin of Tarif?
faq.a: Tarif is associated with Arabic. Tarif is Arabic طَرِيف (Ṭarīf), meaning 'new, novel, rare'.
Yes — the underlying form طَرِيف is Arabic.
Tarif can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Tarif should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Ṭarīf is not a Quranic personal name.
